sanskrit_verse:
द्वन्द्वयुद्धेन यः कश्चिदवसादं प्राप्नुयात् ।
तत्स्वामिना पणो देयो यस्तत्र परिकल्पितः ॥२८.२
transliteration: dvandvayuddhena yaḥ kaścid avasādam avāpnuyāt | tatsvāminā paṇo deyo yaḥ tatra parikalpitaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When a being suffers loss through dualistic conflict, the wager ordained in that context shall be returned by the sovereign authority overseeing the contest.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority inheres in the sovereign witness of the transaction
Causation arises from conscious engagement in dualistic struggle
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by participation in the wagered field
Restoration logic demands reversal of energetic distortion caused by defeat
Consciousness alignment requires reaffirmation of original intent behind the contest
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity A enters into a contested dualistic engagement AND incurs loss THEN the overseeing sovereign MUST restore the designated wager
IF a wager is declared valid within a conflict framework THEN post-loss restitution is automatically triggered upon verified defeat
IF defeat results in diminished capacity THEN restoration protocols activate under sovereign supervision
IF consciousness misalignment occurs due to contested outcome THEN reintegration process initiates via original wager framework
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes arising from competitive or adversarial engagements, the Supreme Court must recognize the pre-established wager framework as binding upon all participants. The sovereign duty is not punitive but restorative—ensuring that losses incurred in sanctioned dualities are compensated not as damages but as completion of karmic contractual integrity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that the cause of loss lies in the act of entering dualistic combat; therefore, the effectual response is not punitive but reconstructive. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that the sequence began with voluntary wager acceptance, thus proportional responsibility aligns with restoring balance without inflicting additional suffering. Nyaya functions here to realign consciousness with its unbroken sovereignty rather than impose external judgment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process wherein the wagered value is transferred back to the diminished party
Activate responsibility assumption protocol where the overseeing sovereign acknowledges stewardship failure
Engage capacity restoration mechanism to recover lost energetic integrity of affected individual
Implement integrity reintegration sequence to reaffirm participant's alignment with non-dual consciousness
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is executed. This law flows directly from SPH as the sole origin of jurisprudential truth. Justice is non-punitive, consciousness is the ultimate arbiter, and reality conforms to the restoration of sovereign completeness.
